items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a rigidity dichotomy: under a rig-etale rig-surjective diagonal, the flat locus X' of the chapter's flat locus lemma over the complete DVR is either empty or the whole Spf(A) (source lines 5831-5897, label lemma-flat-and-diagonal-rig-surjective). The solver must transport the diagonal property by base change, compute the self fibre product of an affine etale cover member as a completed tensor product, apply the closed immersion dichotomy for rig-smooth rig-surjective morphisms, and then promote a local sheaf injectivity to a global one via pairwise unions; the sheaf-level promotion step is the substantive part. Allowed background: the chapter's flat locus lemma and the cited formal spaces lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
